evidence.provenance: Owner session recorded in the amendment's resolved decisions item 3 and odd/tasks/consumer-request-specs.md L6; convention approval forwarded in the implementation handoff.
evidence.interpretation: The amendment records the name choice and first-usage registration; the separately forwarded owner decision approves this exact convention payload. The amendment alone does not promote a global convention. This record is not native review authority.

convention.name: truncate
convention.meaning: Opt in to visually eliding overflowing text to one line without removing its underlying content.
convention.whenToUse: Opt passive text into a single-line ellipsis in a bounded, shrinkable host with a visible route to the complete content.
convention.avoid: Multi-line clamping, data mutation, inline prose, or clipping interactive content.
